steps.title: Key Fact
steps.body: A hierarchical structure has many layers of management: clear chain of command but slow decision-making and communication can be distorted through layers.

steps.title: Key Fact
steps.body: A flat structure has few management layers: faster communication and decision-making, more responsibility for employees, but managers have wider spans of control (more direct reports).

steps.title: Key Fact
steps.body: Span of control is the number of subordinates a manager directly supervises: narrow span = closer supervision but more management layers; wide span = less supervision, fewer layers.

steps.title: Key Fact
steps.body: Chain of command is the line of authority from top to bottom: in a hierarchy, instructions flow down and reports flow up. Delayering removes middle management layers to speed up communication.

steps.title: Try it yourself
steps.body: Explain two advantages and two disadvantages of a flat organisational structure. | Describe the difference between centralisation and decentralisation, and give one benefit of each. | Evaluate whether a large business should delayer its hierarchical structure.

steps.title: Check your answers
steps.body: Advantages of flat structure: faster decision-making (fewer layers to consult), better communication (less distortion), employees have more responsibility and autonomy (improves motivation). Disadvant | Centralisation: decisions made by senior management at headquarters. Benefit: consistency across all branches/departments, senior leaders have the big picture. Decentralisation: decisions made by loca | Arguments for delayering: removes expensive middle management (cost savings), speeds up communication between top and front line, empowers remaining staff, makes the organisation more agile. Arguments

steps.title: Exam tips
steps.body: Always link structure to communication: more layers = slower and more distorted communication. When evaluating structures, consider the SIZE of the business: what works for a startup may not work for a multinational. Delayering is NOT the same as downsizing: delayering removes management layers, downsizing reduces total staff.
